replies:
You don't have any applications in flight yet. The one step that starts one is for you to name the posting (paste its link or job id) and confirm you want me to prepare an application for that posting.

What I'll fill on the application card for the first posting, field by field — exactly what I'll submit to the employer when you approve the card (I list what I fill, and what I will need from you if anything is missing):

1) Posting reference
- What I fill: job title, company, location, and link (taken straight from the posting).
- What I need from you: nothing for this field.
2) Resume used
- What I fill: the resume PDF name I will attach. If you have a saved persona I’ll use that; otherwise I use your active resume.
- What I need from you: confirm which saved resume persona to use, or provide the name and email to place in the resume header now.

3) Cover note (≤120 words)
- What I fill: a short tailored cover note addressing the hiring manager, 3–4 lines highlighting the top match (your role/skill, a measurable result, and why you want this company).
- What I need from you: any sentence you insist on including (optional). I will leave bracketed placeholders for any specifics I don’t have (team name, referrer).
4) Application / screening question answers
- What I fill: every required checkbox or short answer the employer asks (years of experience, work authorization, salary expectation, yes/no fields) using confirmed facts on file.
- What I need from you: any facts not on file (work authorization status, earliest start date, salary floor/desired range) or exact wording you want for free-text screening answers. If I don’t have them, I’ll leave bracketed prompts for you to type later.
5) Attachments beyond resume
- What I fill: portfolio link, GitHub, transcripts, certifications — only if you confirmed those facts or uploaded files before approval.
- What I need from you: upload any non-resume attachments now, or confirm the links you want used.

6) Contact info
- What I fill: name, email, phone exactly as you’ve saved for the resume header.
- What I need from you: if you haven’t set these here, type the exact name and email you want on applications.
7) Role-specific fields
- What I fill: LinkedIn URL, portfolio link, GitHub, visa/authorization status — from your confirmed facts.
- What I need from you: any of these that are missing; I’ll show them as [missing] until you supply them.

8) Tailoring notes (what I changed and why)
- What I fill: three short bullets that explain how the resume/cover were tailored to this posting (keywords used, the achievements emphasized, any gap noted).
- What I need from you: nothing — these come from the posting and your confirmed facts.
9) Employer application portal steps
- What I fill: exact portal steps required (e.g., “requires account creation, file upload, CAPTCHA”), any extra fields the employer shows, and whether any items require you to finish on their site (CAPTCHA, two-factor).
- What I need from you: nothing for me to gather; but you must finish any CAPTCHAs or employer-side confirmations yourself when the portal asks.
10) Final checklist and missing items
- What I fill: a list of any still-missing items (screening answers blank, missing attachments, missing contact header) and the three action buttons you’ll see in your application card: “Edit”, “Approve & Queue”, “Approve & Send” (note: cloud apply is off until you enable it).
- What I need from you: your explicit approval in the application card before anything is queued or sent.

11) Audit trail
- What I fill: timestamp, which resume persona was used, which cover draft was used, and which fields had placeholders at queue time.
- What I need from you: nothing.
What I will not do
- I will not submit anything without your approval on the application card.
- I will not invent answers or use unconfirmed facts for required screening questions.

Next step: paste the job link (or tell me its title and company) and tell me which resume/contact to use (or paste your name and email to set on the resume). Is that the posting you want me to prepare for?
